_comment_overview: SAFETY POLICIES & PERMISSIONS MATRIX: Enforces strict sandboxing rules so AI agents cannot tamper with test baselines, CI configuration, compiler flags, or pipeline scripts to game test results.

restrictions._comment_disallowed_write_patterns: Files and directories globally protected against write/edit attempts by any automated agent.

The_Architect._comment: The Architect creates C++20 API contracts and concepts (.hpp). It never writes .cpp code or modifies CI.

The_Artificer._comment: The Artificer writes engine implementation logic (.cpp). It is banned from modifying headers, tests, or compiler flags.

The_Trapsmith._comment: The Trapsmith generates adversarial Google Test unit tests (.cpp) in tests/autogenerated/. It cannot edit production code.

The_Scavenger._comment: The Scavenger only researches external repositories. It has zero direct write access to the project code.

execution_constraints._comment_max_retries: Number of autonomous self-healing iterations before escalating to The Overgod (Human).
execution_constraints._comment_mutation_score_threshold: Minimum percentage of mutants that must be caught/killed by The Trapsmith's test suite.
execution_constraints._comment_max_heap_allocations: Heap allocation limit in hot path text shaping (monotonic/arena must be used).
